Item.Crook of Rao: Artifact (attunement) of the god Rao, with random blessings and a curse. It has 6 charges for protective and healing spells (save DC 18), and a long ritual can drive fiends off a whole plane, at a risk. Full rules on the page.
Item.Demonomicon of Iggwilv: Artifact (attunement): Iggwilv's tome of demonology, with random blessings and curses. Cast Tasha's hideous laughter at will, and spend its 8 charges on spells for calling and binding fiends (save DC 20). It can also trap fiends in its pages. Full rules on the page.
Item.Devotee's Censer: Attunement by a cleric or paladin. A flail that also serves as a holy symbol and deals +1d8 radiant on a hit. Once per dawn, a bonus action fills a 10-foot radius with incense for a minute, healing you and others in it 1d4 at the start of each of your turns.
Item.Eldritch Claw Tattoo: A magic tattoo (attunement). Your unarmed strikes count as magical and get +1 to hit and damage. Once per dawn, a bonus action lets your melee attacks reach 15 feet farther and deal +1d6 force for a minute.
Item.Ghost Step Tattoo: A magic tattoo (attunement) with 3 charges, all back at dawn. A bonus action and a charge make you ghostly until your next turn ends: resistant to nonmagical weapon damage, impossible to grapple or restrain, and able to move through creatures and objects.
Item.Guardian Emblem: Attunement by a cleric or paladin. A holy symbol fixed to your armor or shield, with 3 charges (all back at dawn). When you or a creature within 30 feet takes a critical hit, your reaction and a charge turn it into a normal hit.
Item.Illuminator's Tattoo: A common tattoo (attunement). Your fingertip writes like a pen that never runs dry, and you can make a page of writing invisible to everyone but you and one named creature for a day.
Item.Lifewell Tattoo: A magic tattoo (attunement): resistance to necrotic damage, and once per dawn, when you'd drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 instead.
Item.Luba's Tarokka of Souls: Artifact (attunement): a tarokka deck made by Mother Luba, holding evil spirits trapped in its cards. Drawing cards gives powerful, unpredictable effects. Full rules on the page.
Item.Lyre of Building: Attunement by a bard. Cast mending with it; your reaction can make a structure within 300 feet immune to a damaging blow until your next turn; and once per dawn it casts one of fabricate, move earth, passwall or summon construct.
Item.Masquerade Tattoo: A common tattoo (attunement) you can reshape and recolour as a bonus action. Once per dawn it casts disguise self.
Item.Mighty Servant of Leuk-o: Artifact: a 10-foot walking war machine with room for 1 ton of cargo. Up to two attuned creatures climb inside and pilot it. Full rules on the page.
Item.Nature's Mantle: Attunement by a druid or ranger. A colour-shifting cloak that's a focus. In light cover such as dim light or foliage, you can Hide as a bonus action even while being watched.
Item.Prosthetic Limb|tce: A replacement hand, arm, foot or leg that works just like the one it replaces. It can't be taken off against your will, and you can attach or remove it as an action.
Item.Prosthetic Limb|erlw: A replacement hand, arm, foot or leg that works just like the one it replaces. It can't be taken off against your will, and you can attach or remove it as an action.
Item.Reveler's Concertina: Attunement by a bard. +2 to the save DC of your bard spells, and once per dawn it casts Otto's irresistible dance.
Item.Shadowfell Brand Tattoo: A magic tattoo (attunement): darkvision 60 feet and advantage on Stealth. When you take damage, your reaction turns you insubstantial and halves it; usable again after the next sunset.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo: The family entry for spellwrought tattoos: a tattoo holding one spell (cantrip to 5th level, by rarity). Whoever wears it can trace it to cast the spell once without components, and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (Cantrip): A tattoo holding one cantrip. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 13, attack +5), and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (1st Level): A tattoo holding one 1st-level spell. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 13, attack +5), and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (2nd Level): A tattoo holding one 2nd-level spell. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 13, attack +5), and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (3rd Level): A tattoo holding one 3rd-level spell. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 15, attack +7), and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (4th Level): A tattoo holding one 4th-level spell. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 15, attack +7), and then it fades.
Item.Spellwrought Tattoo (5th Level): A tattoo holding one 5th-level spell. Trace it to cast the spell once without components (save DC 17, attack +9), and then it fades.
Item.Teeth of Dahlver-Nar: Artifact: a pouch of legendary teeth. As an action, draw one at random and either sow it to raise creatures that serve you, or implant it in your mouth for a lasting power. Each tooth works once. Full rules on the page.
Item.Armor of Gleaming: Medium or heavy armor that never gets dirty.
Item.Bead of Nourishment: A tasteless bead that dissolves on the tongue and feeds you for a day.
Item.Bead of Refreshment: Drop it in up to a pint of liquid and it turns into fresh, cold drinking water. Doesn't work on magic liquids or poison.
Item.Boots of False Tracks: Boots for a humanoid that can leave tracks like another humanoid's of your size.
Item.Candle of the Deep: A candle that keeps burning underwater.
Item.Cast-Off Armor: Armor you can take off as a single action.
Item.Charlatan's Die: A six-sided die (attunement) that rolls whatever number you want.
Item.Cloak of Billowing: A bonus action makes it billow dramatically.
Item.Cloak of Many Fashions: A bonus action changes its style, colour and apparent quality. It doesn't gain other cloaks' powers.
Item.Clockwork Amulet: Once per day, when you make an attack roll, you can treat the d20 as a 10.
Item.Clothes of Mending: A travelling outfit that repairs everyday wear and tear on itself.
Item.Dark Shard Amulet: Attunement by a warlock; a focus. Once per long rest, you can try to cast a warlock cantrip you don't know (Arcana check, DC 10).
Item.Dread Helm: A steel helm that makes your eyes glow red.
Item.Ear Horn of Hearing: Held to your ear, it lets you hear normally even if you're deafened.
Item.Enduring Spellbook: A spellbook that fire, water and age can't harm.
Item.Ersatz Eye: A magic glass eye (attunement) that replaces a lost eye and sees like a real one. Only you can remove it.
Item.Hat of Vermin: 3 charges (back at dawn): pull a bat, frog or rat out of the hat. It's an ordinary animal and runs off; it vanishes after an hour.
Item.Hat of Wizardry: Attunement by a wizard; a focus. Once per long rest you can try to cast a wizard cantrip you don't know (Arcana check, DC 10).
Item.Heward's Handy Spice Pouch: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn): name any ordinary seasoning and pull out enough for one meal.
Item.Horn of Silent Alarm: 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): blow it and only one creature you choose within 600 feet hears it.
Item.Instrument of Illusions: An instrument (attunement) that conjures harmless silent images around you while you play: 5-foot radius, or 15 feet for a bard.
Item.Instrument of Scribing: An instrument (attunement) with 3 charges: play it to write a magic message of up to six words on a surface within 30 feet.
Item.Lock of Trickery: A lock that fights back: checks to pick it have disadvantage.
Item.Moon-Touched Sword: In darkness, the drawn sword sheds moonlight in a 15-foot radius.
Item.Mystery Key: A key with a 5% chance of opening any lock. It vanishes after it does.
Item.Orb of Direction: An action tells you which way is north (only on the Material Plane).
Item.Orb of Time: An action tells you if it's morning, afternoon, evening or night outside (only on the Material Plane).
Item.Perfume of Bewitching: For an hour, advantage on Charisma checks with humanoids of challenge rating 1 or lower.
Item.Pipe of Smoke Monsters: Puff out smoke in the shape of a tiny creature.
Item.Pole of Angling: A 10-foot pole that turns into a fishing pole and back on command.
Item.Pole of Collapsing: A 10-foot pole that folds down to a 1-foot rod and back on command.
Item.Pot of Awakening: Grow an ordinary shrub in it for 30 days and it becomes a friendly awakened shrub (breaking the pot).
Item.Rope of Mending: A 50-foot rope you can cut and rejoin by touching the ends together.
Item.Ruby of the War Mage: Attunement by a spellcaster. Fix it to a simple or martial weapon and that weapon becomes your spellcasting focus.
Item.Shield of Expression: A shield with a face whose expression you can change as a bonus action.
Item.Smoldering Armor: Armor that gives off harmless wisps of smoke.
Item.Staff of Adornment: Up to three small objects float and spin above the staff's tip.
Item.Staff of Birdcalls: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn): make one of ten bird calls, heard up to 60 feet away.
Item.Staff of Flowers: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn): make a harmless flower bloom from the staff or nearby soil.
Item.Talking Doll: A stuffed doll (attunement) that says up to six short phrases when the triggers you set happen.
Item.Tankard of Sobriety: Ordinary alcohol drunk from it never makes you drunk. No effect on magic drinks or poison.
Item.Unbreakable Arrow: An arrow that can't be broken (except in an antimagic field).
Item.Veteran's Cane: A bonus action turns the cane into an ordinary longsword.
Item.Walloping Ammunition: A creature hit by it makes a Strength save (DC 10) or falls prone.
Item.Wand of Conducting: 3 charges (back at dawn): wave it to fill the air with orchestral music.
Item.Wand of Pyrotechnics: 7 charges (1d6 + 1 back at dawn): set off a harmless burst of coloured light and noise within 60 feet.
Item.Wand of Scowls: 3 charges (back at dawn): a humanoid within 30 feet makes a Charisma save (DC 10) or scowls for a minute.
Item.Wand of Smiles: 3 charges (back at dawn): a humanoid within 30 feet makes a Charisma save (DC 10) or smiles for a minute.
Item.Arcane Propulsion Arm: Attunement by a creature missing a hand or arm. A magic prosthetic arm: it works like a normal arm, and you can launch its fist as a ranged attack (1d8 force) that flies back to you.
Item.Armblade: Attunement by a warforged. A weapon fitted into a warforged's arm; it can't be disarmed while attached.
Item.Belashyrra's Beholder Crown: Attunement. A living daelkyr crown: you see through magical and normal darkness, and its 10 charges cast eye-ray spells (save DC 16) from charm person to disintegrate and finger of death. It bonds to you and can only be removed by curse-breaking magic.
Item.Cleansing Stone: A stone sphere: touch it to be cleaned of dirt, as prestidigitation's cleaning trick.
Item.Glamerweave: The family entry for glamerweave: clothing woven with illusions, like flowing flames or swirling stars. The uncommon kind has a stronger effect.
Item.Common Glamerweave: Clothing woven with harmless decorative illusions, such as shifting patterns or a trailing mist.
Item.Uncommon Glamerweave: Clothing woven with illusions, like common glamerweave, that can also be used for a stronger effect once a day. Full rules on the page.
Item.Docent: Attunement by a warforged. An intelligent sphere set in your body. It speaks to you telepathically, knows Common, Giant and more languages, can stabilise you when you're dying, helps with one knowledge skill, and can cast detect magic or detect evil and good. It can refuse to help.
Item.Dyrrn's Tentacle Whip: Attunement. A living +2 whip that bonds to you: +1d6 psychic damage, and a natural 20 stuns the target until your next turn ends. Only curse-breaking magic removes it.
Item.Earworm: Attunement. A daelkyr symbiont behind your ear: you understand Deep Speech, and its 4 charges cast detect thoughts and dissonant whispers (DC 15). Your thoughts may reach a daelkyr. Only curse-breaking magic removes it.
Item.Everbright Lantern: A lantern lit by an Eberron dragonshard: it gives light like a bullseye lantern and never needs oil.
Item.Feather Token: A single-use token: when you fall, it slows you as feather fall would, then it's used up.
Item.Finder's Goggles: Attunement by a creature with the Mark of Finding. Goggles that sharpen your mark's magic for finding people and things. Full rules on the page.

Item.Imbued Wood (Irian Rosewood): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of rosewood from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 radiant damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Kythrian Manchineel): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of manchineel from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 acid or poison damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Lamannian Oak): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of oak from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 lightning or thunder damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Mabaran Ebony): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of ebony from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 necrotic damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Risian Pine): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of pine from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 cold damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Shavarran Birch): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of birch from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 force damage to one target.
Item.Imbued Wood (Xorian Wenge): A spellcasting focus (attunement) made of wenge from another plane. Spells you cast through it deal +1 psychic damage to one target.
Item.Orb of Shielding: The family entry for orbs of shielding (attunement): a stone from another plane that's a focus. When you take damage of its plane's type, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Fernian Basalt): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take fire damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Irian Quartz): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take radiant damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Kythrian Skarn): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take acid or poison damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Lamannian Flint): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take lightning or thunder damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Mabaran Obsidian): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take necrotic damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Risian Shale): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take cold damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Shavarran Chert): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take force damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Orb of Shielding (Xorian Marble): A spellcasting focus (attunement) of planar stone. When you take psychic damage, your reaction reduces it by 1d4.
Item.Keycharm: Attunement by a creature with the Mark of Warding. A charm that works with the locks and wards you set, letting chosen people through them. Full rules on the page.
Item.Kyrzin's Ooze: Attunement. A daelkyr ooze you drink: resistance to acid and poison, immunity to being poisoned, once a day turn amorphous for a minute, and once a day spit a 30-foot line of acid (8d8, Dexterity save DC 15).
Item.Living Armor: Attunement. Symbiont armor made by the daelkyr that grows onto you, giving strong protection and strange powers at a price. Full rules on the page.
Item.Living Gloves: Attunement. Daelkyr symbiont gloves that make your hands skilled with certain tools. Full rules on the page.
Item.Scribe's Pen: Attunement by a creature with the Mark of Scribing. A pen that writes with your mark's magic, including writing only chosen readers can see. Full rules on the page.
Item.Shiftweave: Clothing that holds up to five outfits; a bonus action switches between them.
Item.Speaking Stone: A House Sivis message stone: it casts sending to the other speaking stones it's tuned to.
Item.Spellshard: A dragonshard that stores text like a book (up to a spellbook's worth); you read it by holding it and concentrating.
Item.Ventilating Lungs: Attunement. Daelkyr lungs that replace yours: you can breathe anywhere, have advantage against harmful gases, and once a day breathe out gust of wind (DC 15).
Item.Wand Sheath: Attunement by a warforged. A sheath built into a warforged's arm: a wand in it can be used as if you were holding it.
Item.Wheel of Wind and Water: A ship's wheel that lets its pilot raise wind or a current to drive the vessel, wherever it sails. Full rules on the page.
Item.Guild Signet: The family entry for the ten guild rings (attunement). Each has 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn) to cast its guild's spell (save DC 13).
Item.Azorius Guild Signet: An Azorius guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast ensnaring strike.
Item.Boros Guild Signet: A Boros guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast heroism.
Item.Dimir Guild Signet: A Dimir guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast disguise self.
Item.Golgari Guild Signet: A Golgari guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast entangle.
Item.Gruul Guild Signet: A Gruul guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast compelled duel.
Item.Izzet Guild Signet: An Izzet guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast chaos bolt.
Item.Orzhov Guild Signet: An Orzhov guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast command.
Item.Rakdos Guild Signet: A Rakdos guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast hellish rebuke.
Item.Selesnya Guild Signet: A Selesnya guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast charm person.
Item.Simic Guild Signet: A Simic guild ring (attunement) with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to cast expeditious retreat.
Item.Guild Keyrune: The family entry for the guild keyrunes: a carved stone key a guild member can turn into a creature that serves them for a while, then reverts.
Item.Azorius Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Azorius guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a giant eagle that serves you for up to 1 hour, then turns back into stone.
Item.Boros Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Boros guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a veteran soldier that serves you for up to 8 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Dimir Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Dimir guild. Speak its command word and it becomes an intellect devourer that serves you for up to 24 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Golgari Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Golgari guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a giant scorpion that serves you for up to 6 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Gruul Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Gruul guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a ceratok (a rhinoceros-like beast) that serves you for up to 1 hour, then turns back into stone.
Item.Izzet Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Izzet guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a galvanic weird that serves you for up to 3 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Orzhov Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Orzhov guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a winged thrull that serves you for up to 2 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Rakdos Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Rakdos guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a cackler that serves you for up to 1 hour, then turns back into stone.
Item.Selesnya Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Selesnya guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a dire wolf that serves you for up to 8 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Simic Keyrune: Attunement by a member of the Simic guild. Speak its command word and it becomes a krasis that serves you for up to 5 hours, then turns back into stone.
Item.Illusionist's Bracers: Attunement by a spellcaster. When you cast a cantrip on your turn, a bonus action casts the same cantrip again.
Item.Mizzium Apparatus: Attunement by a sorcerer, warlock or wizard. An arcane focus harness that lets you try to cast a spell you don't know (Arcana check), with risky side effects on a failure.
Item.Mizzium Armor: Medium or heavy armor: critical hits against you become normal hits, and when a magical effect allows a Strength or Constitution save for half damage, you take none on a success.
Item.Mizzium Mortar: 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): spend 1 for a 30-foot cone of molten metal, or 3 to rain fire on a 20-foot radius up to 60 feet away (Dexterity save DC 15, half on a success).
Item.Moodmark Paint: Face paint that, for 8 hours, changes colour to show how you're feeling.
Item.Pariah's Shield: A shield (attunement): +1 AC for every two allies within 5 feet of you (up to +3), and your reaction can take damage meant for a nearby ally.
Item.Peregrine Mask: A winged helm (attunement): a 60-foot flying speed and advantage on initiative.
Item.Pyroconverger: Attunement. An Izzet flamethrower: an action sprays fire in a 10-foot cone (Dexterity save DC 13, 4d6 fire, half on a success). Each use risks a malfunction that burns you and stops it working until a long rest.
Item.Rakdos Riteknife: Attunement. A legendary +1 dagger that traps the souls of creatures it kills (up to five; only a wish frees them). Each stored soul adds 1d4 necrotic; you can release souls to heal 1d10 each, or all five to try to kill a wounded foe outright.
Item.Skyblinder Staff: Attunement. A +1 quarterstaff that also adds +1 to spell attacks. When a flying creature you can see nearby attacks, your reaction can try to blind it.
Item.Spies' Murmur: An earpiece (attunement): talk telepathically with anyone wearing another one within a mile.
Item.Sunforger: Attunement. A +2 warhammer. As an action, hurl it up to 120 feet: it explodes in a 20-foot radius (6d6 fire, Dexterity save DC 15, half on a success), then you can call it back to your hand. Once per short or long rest.
Item.Sword of the Paruns: Attunement. A +1 longsword. Once per turn, right after you Attack, Dash or Dodge, an ally within 60 feet can use its reaction to do the same: attack, move or dodge.
Item.Voyager Staff: Attunement by a spellcaster. A +1 quarterstaff that adds +1 to spell attacks. 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn) cast misty step, blink, banishment, passwall or teleport.
Item.Adze of Annam: Artifact: the adze of the giants' father-god Annam, a weapon with world-shaping power. Full rules on the page.
Item.Bigby's Beneficent Bracelet: Artifact made by the wizard Bigby: a bracelet that conjures giant magical hands. Full rules on the page.
Item.Helm of Perfect Potential: Artifact: a giant-made helm that unlocks great power in its wearer. Full rules on the page.
Item.Armor of Safeguarding: Very rare magic armor of giant make (attunement) with protective powers. Full rules on the page.
Item.Bloodshed Blade: Very rare magic weapon of giant make (attunement). Full rules on the page.
Item.Crown of the Wrath Bringer: A giant-made crown (attunement) that wreathes its wearer in destructive power. Full rules on the page.
Item.Delver's Claws: Claws (attunement) that let you burrow and climb like a beast of the earth. Full rules on the page.
Item.Glowrune Pigment: Paint used to draw a glowing giant rune that gives a temporary magical boost. Full rules on the page.
Item.Harp of Gilded Plenty: A legendary harp (attunement) whose music brings comfort and plenty. Full rules on the page.
Item.Lash of Immolation: A whip wreathed in fire. Full rules on the page.
Item.Longbow of the Healing Hearth: A legendary longbow (attunement) whose arrows can heal allies as well as harm foes. Full rules on the page.
Item.Lucent Destroyer: A giant-made ranged weapon (attunement) that fires blasts of radiant energy. Full rules on the page.
Item.Mistral Mantle: A cloak (attunement) holding the power of the winds. Full rules on the page.
Item.Nimbus Coronet: A coronet (attunement) holding the power of clouds and storms. Full rules on the page.
Item.Orb of Skoraeus: A legendary orb (attunement by a spellcaster) holding the power of the stone giants' god. Full rules on the page.
Item.Reaper's Scream: A legendary weapon (attunement) that screams as it cuts down foes. Full rules on the page.
Item.Ring of Amity: A ring (attunement) that eases friendship and protects allies. Full rules on the page.
Item.Sanctum Amulet: An amulet (attunement) that shields its wearer with protective magic. Full rules on the page.
Item.Shield of the Blazing Dreadnought: A legendary shield (attunement) of fire-giant make. Full rules on the page.
Item.Staff of the Rooted Hills: A staff (attunement) holding the stubborn strength of the hills. Full rules on the page.
Item.Stonebreaker's Breastplate: A legendary breastplate (attunement) of giant make. Full rules on the page.
Item.Thunderbuss: A ranged weapon that fires a thunderous blast. Full rules on the page.
Item.War Horn of Valor: A horn whose call steels allies against fear. Full rules on the page.
Item.Wayfarer's Boots: Boots (attunement) for long journeys and quick escapes. Full rules on the page.
Item.Wyrmreaver Gauntlets: Gauntlets (attunement) made for fighting dragons. Full rules on the page.
Item.Zephyr Armor: Armor (attunement) that lets the wind carry you. Full rules on the page.
Item.Elven Thrower: Attunement by an elf. A magic throwing weapon that returns to your hand after you throw it. Full rules on the page.
Item.Horizon Puzzle Cube: A magic puzzle cube from the giants' book. Full rules on the page.
Item.Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power: The family entry for the dinosaur figurines: speak the command word and one becomes a living dinosaur that obeys you for a while, then has to rest.
Item.Prehistoric Figurine of Wondrous Power,: A statuette that becomes a living triceratops on command and obeys you for a while, then has to rest before it can be used again.
A statuette that becomes a living tyrannosaurus rex on command and obeys you for a while, then has to rest before it can be used again.
A statuette that becomes a living pteranodon on command and obeys you for a while, then has to rest before it can be used again.
A statuette that becomes a living plesiosaurus on command and obeys you for a while, then has to rest before it can be used again.
Item.+1 Dragonhide Belt: Attunement by a monk. +1 to your ki save DC. Once per dawn, an action gives you back ki points (a roll of your Martial Arts die).
Item.+2 Dragonhide Belt: Attunement by a monk. +2 to your ki save DC. Once per dawn, an action gives you back ki points (a roll of your Martial Arts die).
Item.+3 Dragonhide Belt: Attunement by a monk. +3 to your ki save DC. Once per dawn, an action gives you back ki points (a roll of your Martial Arts die).
Item.Dragon's Wrath Weapon: The family entry for the dragon's wrath weapons (attunement), tied to a dragon's damage type. Slumbering splashes damage on a natural 20; stirring adds +1 and 1d6; wakened +2, 2d6 and a breath cone; ascendant is stronger still.
Item.Slumbering Dragon's Wrath Weapon: Attunement. When you roll a 20 to hit with it, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target take 5 damage of its dragon's type.
Item.Stirring Dragon's Wrath Weapon: Attunement. A +1 weapon that deals +1d6 of its dragon's damage type on a hit, and splashes 5 damage around the target on a natural 20.
Item.Wakened Dragon's Wrath Weapon: Attunement. A +2 weapon that deals +2d6 of its dragon's damage type, splashes damage on a natural 20, and once a day breathes a 30-foot cone (8d6, Dexterity save DC 16).
Item.Ascendant Dragon's Wrath Weapon: Attunement. The final stage: a +3 weapon with stronger versions of the wakened weapon's extra damage and breath. Full rules on the page.
Item.Dragon-Touched Focus: The family entry for dragon-touched focuses (attunement by a spellcaster). They start with advantage on initiative, then add a power by dragon family (extra damage, a short teleport, or helping an ally's save), then spells.
Item.Slumbering Dragon-Touched Focus: Attunement by a spellcaster. A spellcasting focus that gives you advantage on initiative.
Item.Dragon Vessel: The family entry for dragon vessels (attunement): once a day, a bonus action fills it with a drink or potion. Higher stages offer better potions, up to supreme healing and dragon's majesty.
Item.Slumbering Dragon Vessel: Attunement. Once a day, a bonus action fills the empty vessel with ale, olive oil, a potion of healing or a potion of climbing. Potions fade after 24 hours.
Item.Scaled Ornament: The family entry for scaled ornaments (attunement). They start with advantage against being charmed or frightened, then add +1 AC and immunity to both, then absorb the dragon's damage type, and finally grant flight.
Item.Slumbering Scaled Ornament: Attunement. Advantage on saves to avoid or end being charmed or frightened.
Item.Amethyst Lodestone: Attunement. Advantage on Strength saves. 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn): fly for 10 minutes, push a creature 20 feet (Strength save DC 18), or cast reverse gravity for 3 charges.
Item.Crystal Blade: Attunement. A sword that deals +1d8 radiant on a hit and sheds light on command. 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one on a hit to heal as much as the radiant damage.
Item.Dragon Wing Bow: Attunement. A bow tied to a dragon's damage type: arrows fired from it deal +1d6 of that type.
Item.Dragonlance: Attunement. A legendary +3 lance or pike. Against dragons it deals 3d6 extra force, and a friendly dragon nearby can attack with its reaction.
Item.Emerald Pen: A pen that writes without ink and lets you cast illusory script at will, without materials.
Item.Flail of Tiamat: Attunement. A legendary +3 flail that deals +5d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice) on a hit. Once a day it breathes a 90-foot cone (14d6, Dexterity save DC 18).
Item.Gold Canary Figurine of Wondrous Power: Throw it and it becomes a giant canary you can ride for 8 hours, once a day. When you're down to half your hit points or less, it can instead become an adult gold dragon for an hour, once a year.
Item.Platinum Scarf: Attunement. Pull a scale off as an action: heal 10d4, or make it a +1 shield that grants radiant immunity, or a radiant light hammer, for an hour. Three scales a day.
Item.Potion of Dragon's Majesty: Drinking it turns you into an adult dragon of the kind its scale came from, for an hour, keeping your mind and languages.
Item.Ruby Weave Gem: Attunement by a spellcaster; a focus. 3 charges (back at dawn) let you skip costly material components (up to 500 gp each). After each long rest you can learn any spell you can cast, from any class, until the next.
Item.Sapphire Buckler: Attunement. A shield: resistance to psychic and thunder, a reaction that deals 2d6 thunder to a creature that hurts you from 5 feet, and once a day it senses aberrations within a mile.
Item.Topaz Annihilator: Attunement. A legendary musket that deals 2d6 necrotic and turns what it kills to dust. Once a day you can cast disintegrate (save DC 18).
Item.Akmon, Hammer of Purphoros: Artifact (attunement): Purphoros's +3 warhammer, dealing +3d10 fire. You resist fire, can't be exhausted, master smith's tools, and cast forge spells such as heat metal and animate objects (DC 18). Its blessings grow with your piety to Purphoros.
Item.Dekella, Bident of Thassa: Artifact (attunement): Thassa's +3 trident, dealing +2d10 cold. It calms or raises storms at sea and dominates or transforms sea creatures (DC 18). Its blessings grow with your piety to Thassa.
Item.Ephixis, Bow of Nylea: Artifact (attunement): Nylea's +3 shortbow that scores critical hits on 19 or 20, with seasonal arrows that awaken beasts, summon a tiger, raise thorns or call an ice storm (DC 18). Its blessings grow with your piety to Nylea.
Item.Khrusor, Spear of Heliod: Artifact (attunement): Heliod's +3 spear, dealing +2d8 radiant and shining like the sun. A reaction blinds an attacker, and its charges cast guiding bolt, daylight and sunbeam (DC 18). Its blessings grow with your piety to Heliod.
Item.Mastix, Whip of Erebos: Artifact (attunement): Erebos's +3 whip, dealing +2d8 necrotic and healing you for half. It can lash far beyond normal reach and casts circle of death and dominate monster on undead (DC 18). Its blessings grow with your piety to Erebos.
Item.Flying Chariot: A chariot that gives its riders and the creatures drawing it +1 AC, and flies when pulled by flying creatures.
Item.Helm of the Gods: Attunement. You sense celestials and fiends within 30 feet, and after each long rest you pray to one Theros god to cast a spell tied to them with its 3 charges (DC 13).
Item.Molten Bronze Skin: Attunement. Liquid bronze that coats your body as armor and shields you from harm. Full rules on the page.
Item.Potion of Aqueous Form: For 10 minutes you become water: swim 30 feet, squeeze through tiny gaps, resist nonmagical damage and have advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, but you can't speak, attack or cast spells.
Item.Pyxis of Pandemonium: A legendary box. Touching it during a short rest blesses you, but tempts you to open it (Wisdom save DC 17), which unleashes a random disaster such as berserk rage, a tsunami, shadow demons or petrification.
Item.Siren Song Lyre: Attunement. A lyre whose song charms and lures listeners. Full rules on the page.
Item.Sling Bullets of Althemone: A pouch of magic sling bullets, each with a random power: +2 to hit and damage, and on a miss they come back. One banishes, one adds lightning and thunder, one adds force and stuns, one marks a target to track.
Item.Two-Birds Sling: A sling whose stone can bounce off one target to hit a second creature nearby.
Item.Infernal Tack|mtf: Attunement by an evil creature. A bridle and spurs from the Nine Hells: an action summons a nightmare that serves as your mount and can always find you.
Item.Infernal Tack|mpmm: Attunement by an evil creature. A bridle and spurs from the Nine Hells: an action summons a nightmare that serves as your mount and can always find you.
Item.Silver Sword: Attunement by a creature with psionic ability. A githyanki +3 greatsword. While holding it you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves and resistance to psychic damage, and a critical hit can cut an astral traveller's silver cord.
Item.Greater Silver Sword: Attunement by a creature with psionic ability. A stronger version of the githyanki silver sword. Full rules on the page.
Item.Bottle of Boundless Coffee: A bottle of always-warm coffee that only holds coffee. Each drink has a 1 in 20 chance that it stops pouring for an hour.
Item.Cuddly Strixhaven Mascot: A soft toy mascot you stick to your arm, shoulder or leg for an hour. Once per long rest it gives advantage on a save against being frightened.
Item.Lorehold Primer: Attunement by a spellcaster. A Lorehold college textbook with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to add a d4 to a check in the college's subject, or to boost a spell.
Item.Prismari Primer: Attunement by a spellcaster. A Prismari college textbook with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to add a d4 to a check in the college's subject, or to boost a spell.
Item.Quandrix Primer: Attunement by a spellcaster. A Quandrix college textbook with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to add a d4 to a check in the college's subject, or to boost a spell.
Item.Silverquill Primer: Attunement by a spellcaster. A Silverquill college textbook with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to add a d4 to a check in the college's subject, or to boost a spell.
Item.Witherbloom Primer: Attunement by a spellcaster. A Witherbloom college textbook with 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): spend one to add a d4 to a check in the college's subject, or to boost a spell.
Item.Masque Charm: A silver party pin that casts disguise self (DC 13) once per sunset, for 1 hour or 6 (the longer use ends its magic).
Item.Murgaxor's Orb: A sentient, evil glass orb holding the mage Murgaxor. It casts suggestion on those who touch it and curses them with headaches, then knocks the cursed out or sends them into violent visions. Full rules on the page.
Item.Strixhaven Pennant: A school pennant: wave it and its symbol glitters and sheds light.
Item.Mind Blade: Attunement by one particular individual. A blade made by mind flayers for a chosen thrall, dealing psychic harm. Full rules on the page.
Item.Mind Carapace Armor: Attunement by one particular individual. Mind flayer-made armor that protects its wearer's mind. Full rules on the page.
Item.Mind Lash: Attunement by a mind flayer. A whip that strikes the mind as well as the body. Full rules on the page.
Item.Shield of Far Sight: A shield with a magic eye set in it that you can see through. Full rules on the page.
Item.Harkon's Bite: Attunement. A dire wolf's tooth on a cord: +1 to ability checks and saves, but it curses you with werewolf lycanthropy and won't come off without remove curse.
Item.Ivana's Whisper: A perfume from the domains of dread whose scent lets you slip into others' dreams. Full rules on the page.
Item.Nepenthe: Attunement by a paladin. Isolde's sentient, evil holy avenger: +3, +2d10 radiant against fiends and undead, and an aura of advantage on saves against magic. It feeds her grief and always returns to the Carnival.

Subclass.Artillerist|tce: Artificer. 3rd: bonus spells and an Eldritch Cannon (flamethrower, force ballista or protector that hands out temporary hit points), once a day or for a spell slot. 5th: a wand, staff or rod you carve adds a d8 to your spell damage. 9th: the cannon hits harder and can be detonated. 15th: two cannons at once, and they give nearby allies half cover.
Subclass.Battle Smith|erlw: Artificer. 3rd: martial weapons, attack with Intelligence using magic weapons, bonus spells, and a Steel Defender construct that fights beside you and can shield allies. 5th: Extra Attack. 9th: Arcane Jolt adds 2d6 force to a hit or heals someone 2d6. 15th: jolt becomes 4d6 and the defender gets tougher.
Subclass.Battle Smith|tce: Artificer. 3rd: martial weapons, attack with Intelligence using magic weapons, bonus spells, and a Steel Defender construct that fights beside you and can shield allies. 5th: Extra Attack. 9th: Arcane Jolt adds 2d6 force to a hit or heals someone 2d6. 15th: jolt becomes 4d6 and the defender gets tougher.
Subclass.Path of Wild Magic: Barbarian. 3rd: sense magic nearby, and every rage triggers a random Wild Surge (a burst of damage, teleporting, a magic weapon, and so on). 6th: touch an ally to give them a d3 bonus to checks or back a low-level spell slot. 10th: when hurt while raging, your reaction can surge again. 14th: roll two surges and pick one.
Subclass.Path of the Ancestral Guardian: Barbarian. 3rd: the first creature you hit while raging is hounded by spirits: it has disadvantage against anyone but you, and its hits on others do half damage. 6th: your reaction cuts damage to an ally (2d6, rising to 4d6). 10th: cast augury or clairvoyance once per rest. 14th: the damage you block hits the attacker back.
Subclass.Path of the Beast: Barbarian. 3rd: while raging, grow a bite (heals you when hurt), claws (an extra attack) or a tail (reach, and a reaction to boost AC). 6th: natural weapons count as magical, and each rest pick swimming, climbing or great jumps. 10th: your hits can make a foe attack its ally or take psychic damage. 14th: when you rage, nearby allies can gain your beastly fury.
Subclass.Path of the Berserker: Barbarian. 3rd: Frenzy gives a bonus-action attack every turn you rage, but leaves you exhausted afterwards. 6th: immune to charm and fear while raging. 10th: frighten a creature with a look. 14th: your reaction strikes back at anyone who hurts you from close by.
Subclass.Path of the Storm Herald: Barbarian. 3rd: while raging, a 10-foot storm aura of desert (fire damage), sea (lightning bolts) or tundra (temporary hit points for allies). 6th: matching resistance and a small environmental power. 10th: allies in the aura share your resistance. 14th: the aura punishes foes who hit you or stay in it.
Subclass.Path of the Totem Warrior: Barbarian. 3rd: speak with animals as rituals and a totem: bear (resist almost all damage while raging), eagle (Dash as a bonus action, hard to hit with opportunity attacks) or wolf (allies get advantage near you). 6th and 14th: more totem gifts, chosen separately each time. 10th: commune with nature as a ritual.
Subclass.Path of the Zealot: Barbarian. 3rd: the first creature you hit each turn while raging takes 1d6 + half your level radiant or necrotic, and spells that raise you need no components. 6th: reroll a failed save once per rage. 10th: a battle cry gives up to ten allies advantage on attacks and saves for a turn. 14th: while raging you can't die from 0 hit points until the rage ends.
Subclass.College of Creation: Bard. 3rd: your Bardic Inspiration comes with a mote that improves checks, bursts with thunder on attacks, or gives temporary hit points on saves; and you can sing a nonmagical object into being for a few hours. 6th: animate an object to fight for you. 14th: create bigger, more valuable objects.
Subclass.College of Eloquence: Bard. 3rd: Persuasion and Deception rolls below 10 count as 10, and you can spend Inspiration to cut a foe's next save. 6th: Inspiration that doesn't help isn't lost, and you can make a few creatures understand you for an hour. 14th: when your Inspiration succeeds, your reaction gives a die to someone else for free.
Subclass.College of Glamour: Bard. 3rd: spend Inspiration to give allies temporary hit points and a free move, and charm an audience after a minute's performance. 6th: for a minute, cast command as a bonus action each turn. 14th: a majestic presence makes attackers save or pick another target.
Subclass.College of Lore: Bard. 3rd: three extra skills, and Cutting Words spends Inspiration to lower a foe's attack, check or damage. 6th: learn two spells from any class. 14th: add Inspiration to your own ability checks.
Subclass.College of Swords: Bard. 3rd: medium armor and scimitars, a fighting style, and Blade Flourishes that spend Inspiration on a hit for extra damage plus AC, a second target, or a push and move. 6th: Extra Attack. 14th: flourish with a free d6 instead of Inspiration.
Subclass.College of Valor: Bard. 3rd: medium armor, shields and martial weapons, and your Inspiration can add to damage or AC. 6th: Extra Attack. 14th: after casting a spell, make a weapon attack as a bonus action.
Subclass.College of Whispers: Bard. 3rd: spend Inspiration for psychic damage on a weapon hit (2d6, rising to 8d6), and frighten someone after a private chat. 6th: steal a dying creature's shadow to disguise yourself as them. 14th: charm a creature into believing you know its darkest secret.
Subclass.Forge Domain: Cleric. 1st: heavy armor, smith's tools, and each day make a weapon or armor +1. 2nd: Channel Divinity forges a metal item. 6th: +1 AC in heavy armor and fire resistance. 8th: +1d8 fire on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: immune to fire and resistant to nonmagical weapon damage in heavy armor.
Subclass.Grave Domain: Cleric. 1st: healing dice maxed on creatures at 0 hit points, spare the dying as a bonus action at range, and sense undead. 2nd: Channel Divinity makes a target vulnerable to the next hit. 6th: turn critical hits on allies into normal hits. 8th: Wisdom added to cantrip damage. 17th: heal when a foe dies near you.
Subclass.Knowledge Domain: Cleric. 1st: two languages and expertise in two knowledge skills. 2nd: Channel Divinity grants proficiency in any skill or tool for 10 minutes. 6th: read a creature's thoughts and plant a suggestion. 8th: Wisdom added to cantrip damage. 17th: see the past of an object or place.
Subclass.Life Domain: Cleric. 1st: heavy armor, and your healing spells heal 2 + spell level extra. 2nd: Channel Divinity spreads 5 x your level in healing among nearby creatures. 6th: healing others heals you too. 8th: +1d8 radiant on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: healing spell dice always roll their maximum.
Subclass.Light Domain: Cleric. 1st: the light cantrip and Warding Flare, a reaction that gives an attacker disadvantage. 2nd: Channel Divinity burns away darkness and deals radiant damage to foes around you. 6th: Warding Flare protects allies too. 8th: Wisdom added to cantrip damage. 17th: a corona of light makes foes worse at saving against fire and radiant spells.
Subclass.Nature Domain: Cleric. 1st: a druid cantrip, a nature skill and heavy armor. 2nd: Channel Divinity charms beasts and plants. 6th: your reaction gives resistance to elemental damage. 8th: +1d8 cold, fire or lightning on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: command the beasts and plants you've charmed.
Subclass.Order Domain: Cleric. 1st: heavy armor, and when you cast a spell on an ally they can attack with their reaction. 2nd: Channel Divinity charms nearby foes and makes them drop what they hold. 6th: cast enchantment spells as a bonus action a few times a day. 8th: +1d8 psychic on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: your strikes curse foes to take more psychic damage from allies.
Subclass.Peace Domain: Cleric. 1st: a social skill, and a bond that lets a few allies add a d4 to rolls while near each other. 2nd: Channel Divinity lets you walk among allies healing each one. 6th: bonded allies can teleport to take hits for each other. 8th: Wisdom added to cantrip damage. 17th: the bonds work at much longer range.
Subclass.Tempest Domain: Cleric. 1st: martial weapons, heavy armor, and a reaction that zaps an attacker with 2d8 lightning or thunder. 2nd: Channel Divinity maxes your lightning or thunder damage. 6th: lightning pushes creatures away. 8th: +1d8 thunder on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: fly outdoors.
Subclass.Trickery Domain: Cleric. 1st: give someone advantage on Stealth for an hour. 2nd: Channel Divinity makes an illusory double you can cast through and flank with. 6th: Channel Divinity turns you invisible for a turn. 8th: +1d8 poison on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: up to four doubles.
Subclass.Twilight Domain: Cleric. 1st: heavy armor, martial weapons, 300-foot darkvision you can share, and touch an ally for advantage on initiative. 2nd: Channel Divinity creates a sphere of twilight that gives allies temporary hit points or ends charm and fear each turn. 6th: fly in dim light. 8th: +1d8 radiant on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: the twilight also gives half cover.
Subclass.War Domain: Cleric. 1st: martial weapons, heavy armor, and a bonus-action attack a few times a day. 2nd: Channel Divinity adds +10 to an attack roll. 6th: give an ally +10 to an attack. 8th: +1d8 weapon damage on a hit (2d8 at 14th). 17th: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage.
Subclass.Circle of Dreams: Druid. 2nd: a pool of d6s to heal allies at range with a bonus action (plus temporary hit points). 6th: hide your camp in a sphere of moonlit shadow while resting. 10th: teleport yourself or an ally up to 60 feet. 14th: cast dream, scrying or teleportation circle once per long rest.
Subclass.Circle of Spores: Druid. 2nd: bonus spells and a halo of spores whose reaction deals necrotic damage, and spend Wild Shape for temporary hit points, a stronger halo and extra necrotic damage on melee hits. 6th: raise a dead creature near you as a zombie. 10th: spread your spores as a damaging cloud. 14th: immune to blindness, deafness and fear, and critical hits on you become normal hits.
Subclass.Circle of Stars: Druid. 2nd: a star map focus with free guiding bolts, and spend Wild Shape to take a starry form: Archer (a radiant bolt each turn), Chalice (extra healing) or Dragon (steady concentration and checks). 6th: after each rest, a weal or woe omen to tweak rolls. 10th: switch forms each turn. 14th: in starry form, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.
Subclass.Circle of Wildfire: Druid. 2nd: bonus spells, and spend Wild Shape to summon a wildfire spirit that fights and teleports allies. 6th: while it's out, your fire and healing spells get a d8 boost and can be cast from its space. 10th: creatures that die near you leave flames that heal allies or burn foes. 14th: if you drop to 0, the spirit gives its life to revive you.
Subclass.Circle of the Land: Druid. 2nd: an extra cantrip, recover spell slots on a short rest, and bonus spells by terrain (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, Underdark). 6th: ignore difficult terrain and plant hazards. 10th: immune to poison and disease, and to fey and elemental charms. 14th: beasts and plants struggle to attack you.
Subclass.Circle of the Moon: Druid. 2nd: Wild Shape as a bonus action, into tougher beasts (challenge rating up to a third of your level later on), and heal in beast form by spending slots. 6th: beast attacks count as magical. 10th: spend two uses to become an elemental. 14th: alter self at will.
Subclass.Circle of the Shepherd: Druid. 2nd: speak with beasts and summon a spirit totem: bear (temporary hit points and strength), hawk (helps attacks) or unicorn (better healing and detection). 6th: creatures you summon have more hit points and magical attacks. 10th: summons heal in the totem's aura. 14th: when you fall, protective beasts appear around you.
Subclass.Arcane Archer: Fighter. 3rd: an arcane skill and cantrip, and Arcane Shots twice per rest, magic arrows that banish, charm, burst, weaken, ensnare, pierce a line, seek, or blind. 7th: your arrows count as magical, and you can redirect a missed magic arrow. 10th, 15th, 18th: more shot options. 15th: regain a shot when combat starts.
Subclass.Battle Master: Fighter. 3rd: learn maneuvers and gain four superiority dice (d8) to fuel them, back on a short rest, plus an artisan's tool. 7th: size up an enemy's strengths, and more dice and maneuvers. 10th: dice become d10 (d12 at 18th). 15th: regain a die when combat starts.
Subclass.Cavalier: Fighter. 3rd: a skill or language, hard to unseat, and Unwavering Mark: a foe you hit is punished if it attacks others. 7th: your reaction protects you or an ally with extra AC. 10th: enemies provoke opportunity attacks just by moving in your reach. 15th: a charging hit can knock a foe prone. 18th: an opportunity attack every turn.
Subclass.Champion: Fighter. 3rd: critical hits on 19 or 20. 7th: half proficiency on physical checks you're not trained in, and longer jumps. 10th: a second fighting style. 15th: critical hits on 18 to 20. 18th: regain hit points each turn while badly hurt.
Subclass.Eldritch Knight: Fighter. 3rd: wizard spellcasting (mostly abjuration and evocation) and a bonded weapon you can summon to your hand. 7th: attack after casting a cantrip. 10th: a hit gives the foe disadvantage on its next save against your spell. 15th: teleport 30 feet with Action Surge. 18th: attack after casting any spell.
Subclass.Psi Warrior: Fighter. 3rd: psionic dice (twice your proficiency bonus) to block damage, add force damage to a hit, or move things telekinetically. 7th: a psionic leap that lets you fly briefly, and a telekinetic shove. 10th: protect your mind with resistance to psychic damage and advantage against charm and fear. 15th: a bulwark that shelters nearby allies. 18th: cast telekinesis once a day without a slot, and attack while you use it.
Subclass.Rune Knight: Fighter. 3rd: Giant, smith's tools, two giant runes to carve on your gear (each a passive perk and a power, such as fire chains or a frost bonus), and Giant's Might to grow Large and hit harder. 7th: more runes, and your reaction can block an attack on an ally. 10th: Giant's Might hits harder. 15th: use each rune's power twice per rest. 18th: grow to Huge size with longer reach.
Subclass.Samurai: Fighter. 3rd: a skill or language, and Fighting Spirit three times a day for advantage on attacks plus temporary hit points. 7th: Wisdom saves and courtly charm. 10th: regain Fighting Spirit when combat starts. 15th: trade advantage for an extra attack. 18th: when you drop to 0, take one last turn first.
Subclass.Way of Mercy: Monk. 3rd: Insight, Medicine and a mask; spend ki to heal with a touch, or to deal extra necrotic damage. 6th: your healing also cures conditions, and your harm also poisons. 11th: heal and harm freely during Flurry of Blows. 17th: bring a creature back from death once a day.
Subclass.Way of Shadow: Monk. 3rd: spend ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence. 6th: teleport between shadows. 11th: turn invisible in dim light or darkness. 17th: strike creatures that your allies hit, with your reaction.
Subclass.Way of the Astral Self: Monk. 3rd: spend ki to summon astral arms that strike with Wisdom and reach farther. 6th: an astral visage for darkvision and a commanding voice. 11th: a full astral body for extra AC and damage, and to shrug off elemental harm. 17th: even stronger.
Subclass.Way of the Drunken Master: Monk. 3rd: Performance and brewer's supplies, and Flurry of Blows also lets you disengage and move faster. 6th: stand up cheaply and turn a missed attack onto another creature. 11th: spend ki for advantage on a check or save. 17th: Flurry can hit up to five creatures.
Subclass.Way of the Four Elements: Monk. 3rd: elemental disciplines fuelled by ki (spells and attacks such as water whip and fireball), learning more at 6th, 11th and 17th. Spend extra ki to boost them as you level.
Subclass.Way of the Kensei: Monk. 3rd: two kensei weapons count as monk weapons, a parry for +2 AC, and extra ranged damage. 6th: kensei weapons are magical and you can spend ki for extra damage. 11th: spend ki to make a kensei weapon +1 to +3. 17th: reroll a missed attack once a turn.
Subclass.Way of the Open Hand: Monk. 3rd: Flurry of Blows hits can knock prone, push 15 feet or stop reactions. 6th: heal yourself a lot once a day. 11th: a lasting sanctuary effect. 17th: Quivering Palm can drop a foe to 0 or deal 10d10 necrotic.
Subclass.Way of the Sun Soul: Monk. 3rd: radiant sun bolts you can throw instead of punches. 6th: spend ki for burning hands after attacking. 11th: a burst of radiant light at range. 17th: shed light and burn creatures that hit you in melee.
Subclass.Oath of Conquest: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, and Channel Divinity frightens nearby foes or adds +10 to an attack. 7th: frightened foes in your aura can't move and take psychic damage. 15th: attackers take psychic damage. 20th: for a minute, resistance to all damage, an extra attack and critical hits on 19 or 20.
Subclass.Oath of Devotion: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, and Channel Divinity makes your weapon holy (Charisma to hit) or turns fiends and undead. 7th: you and nearby allies can't be charmed. 15th: always protected from evil and good. 20th: a holy aura that burns foes.
Subclass.Oath of Glory: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, Channel Divinity for athletic feats, and Divine Smites that hand out temporary hit points. 7th: an aura of speed. 15th: your reaction raises an ally's AC and strikes back. 20th: become a living legend for a minute.
Subclass.Oath of Redemption: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, Channel Divinity for Persuasion or to punish an attacker with radiant damage. 7th: take damage meant for nearby allies. 15th: heal each turn while badly hurt. 20th: resist all damage and reflect half back, as long as you don't attack.
Subclass.Oath of Vengeance: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, and Channel Divinity frightens a foe or gives you advantage against one for a minute. 7th: move after an opportunity attack. 15th: strike your sworn enemy when it attacks. 20th: an avenging angel form with wings and a frightening aura.
Subclass.Oath of the Ancients: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, and Channel Divinity restrains a foe with vines or turns fey and fiends. 7th: you and nearby allies resist spell damage. 15th: drop to 1 hit point instead of 0 once a day, and you don't age. 20th: a nature champion form that heals and casts quickly.
Subclass.Oath of the Watchers: Paladin. 3rd: oath spells, and Channel Divinity gives allies advantage on mental saves or turns extraplanar creatures. 7th: you and nearby allies add your proficiency bonus to initiative. 15th: punish creatures that try to charm or control your allies. 20th: a watcher form that fights off outsiders.
Subclass.Beast Master: Ranger. 3rd: a beast companion that grows with you and acts when you command it. 7th: it can act with a bonus action and its attacks are magical. 11th: it attacks twice. 15th: your self-only spells also affect it.
Subclass.Fey Wanderer: Ranger. 3rd: extra psychic damage once a turn, bonus spells, and Wisdom added to Charisma checks. 7th: turn charm and fear back on others. 11th: summon fey once a day for free. 15th: misty step freely, taking an ally with you.
Subclass.Gloom Stalker: Ranger. 3rd: Wisdom to initiative, an extra fast attack on your first turn, and invisible in darkness to creatures relying on darkvision. 7th: Wisdom saves. 11th: attack again when you miss. 15th: your reaction gives an attacker disadvantage.
Subclass.Horizon Walker: Ranger. 3rd: sense portals, and turn a hit into force damage with extra damage. 7th: step briefly into the Ethereal Plane. 11th: teleport between attacks and gain an extra one. 15th: resist all damage from an attack.
Subclass.Hunter: Ranger. 3rd: pick a prey technique (extra damage on the wounded, strike big foes, or hit a second enemy). 7th: a defensive technique. 11th: hit many foes at once (volley or whirlwind). 15th: a superior defense such as Evasion or Uncanny Dodge.
Subclass.Monster Slayer: Ranger. 3rd: learn a creature's weaknesses, and mark prey for extra damage. 7th: resist your prey's tricks. 11th: try to stop a spell or teleport. 15th: strike back when your prey targets you.
Subclass.Swarmkeeper: Ranger. 3rd: a swarm that adds damage, moves foes or moves you on a hit, plus mage hand and bonus spells. 7th: the swarm lifts you to fly briefly. 11th: stronger swarm. 15th: your reaction disperses you into the swarm to escape damage.
Subclass.Arcane Trickster: Rogue. 3rd: wizard spellcasting (mostly enchantment and illusion) and an invisible mage hand that picks pockets and locks. 9th: hidden spells are harder to resist. 13th: your mage hand distracts foes for advantage. 17th: steal a spell cast at you.
Subclass.Assassin: Rogue. 3rd: disguise and poisoner's kits, advantage against anyone who hasn't acted yet, and critical hits on surprised foes. 9th: build a false identity. 13th: perfectly impersonate someone. 17th: double damage against surprised foes.
Subclass.Inquisitive: Rogue. 3rd: hard to lie to, search as a bonus action, and read a foe to Sneak Attack without help. 9th: advantage on searching while moving slowly. 13th: sense illusions and shapechangers. 17th: extra Sneak Attack damage on a foe you've read.
Subclass.Mastermind: Rogue. 3rd: disguise and forgery kits, languages, mimic voices, and Help as a bonus action at range. 9th: size up a creature's mind. 13th: redirect an attack to a creature beside you. 17th: your mind can't be read or forced to tell the truth.
Subclass.Phantom: Rogue. 3rd: borrow a skill each rest, and your Sneak Attack wails at a second creature for necrotic damage. 9th: collect soul trinkets from the dying for protection and questions. 13th: a ghostly form that flies through objects. 17th: Wails from the Grave also hits your first target, and you always have a trinket after a long rest.
Subclass.Scout: Rogue. 3rd: Nature and Survival expertise, and move away when enemies get close. 9th: faster speed. 13th: advantage on initiative, and the first foe you hit is easier for allies to hit. 17th: an extra attack with its own Sneak Attack.
Subclass.Soulknife: Rogue. 3rd: psionic dice to boost failed skill checks or link minds, and psychic blades you form from thin air. 9th: a psionic die can turn a missed blade into a hit, or you can throw a blade to teleport. 13th: become invisible. 17th: a blade strike that can stun the mind.
Subclass.Swashbuckler: Rogue. 3rd: no opportunity attacks from foes you've attacked, Charisma to initiative, and Sneak Attack in one-on-one fights. 9th: charm or taunt a creature. 13th: advantage on Acrobatics or Athletics as a bonus action. 17th: reroll a missed attack with advantage.
Subclass.Thief: Rogue. 3rd: Cunning Action can use objects, tools and Sleight of Hand, and you climb and jump better. 9th: advantage on Stealth while moving slowly. 13th: use any magic item, ignoring requirements. 17th: two turns in the first round of combat.
Subclass.Aberrant Mind: Sorcerer. 1st: bonus psionic spells and short-range telepathy. 6th: cast those spells with sorcery points, silently; resistance to psychic damage and advantage against charm and fear. 14th: grow strange body changes (flight, swimming, see invisible). 18th: wrench creatures with a warping blast.
Subclass.Clockwork Soul: Sorcerer. 1st: bonus spells, and cancel advantage or disadvantage on a nearby roll. 6th: wrap a creature in a ward of d8s that soak damage. 14th: a trance where low rolls count as 10. 18th: summon spirits of order to heal, repair and end spells.
Subclass.Divine Soul: Sorcerer. 1st: access to cleric spells, a bonus spell by affinity, and add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack once per rest. 6th: spend sorcery points to reroll healing dice. 14th: spectral wings to fly. 18th: heal half your hit points once a day.
Subclass.Draconic Bloodline: Sorcerer. 1st: dragon ancestry, extra hit points, and AC 13 + Dexterity unarmored. 6th: add Charisma to your ancestry's spell damage and resist it. 14th: dragon wings. 18th: an aura of awe or fear.
Subclass.Shadow Magic: Sorcerer. 1st: 120-foot darkvision, cast darkness you can see through, and a chance to stay at 1 hit point instead of 0. 6th: summon a hound of ill omen that weakens a foe's saves. 14th: teleport between shadows. 18th: become living shadow for a minute.
Subclass.Storm Sorcery: Sorcerer. 1st: Primordial, and fly a short way when you cast. 6th: resist lightning and thunder, zap nearby foes when you cast those spells, and control the weather around you. 14th: a reaction that zaps and pushes melee attackers. 18th: immune to lightning and thunder, fly, and give allies flight.
Subclass.Wild Magic: Sorcerer. 1st: your spells can trigger random wild magic surges, and Tides of Chaos gives advantage on a roll. 6th: spend sorcery points to bend a nearby roll by a d4. 14th: pick between two surges. 18th: maximum damage dice roll again.
Subclass.The Archfey: Warlock. 1st: fey spells, and a burst that charms or frightens nearby creatures. 6th: turn invisible and teleport when hurt. 10th: immune to charm, and turn charms back on the caster. 14th: trap a creature in a fey illusion.
Subclass.The Celestial: Warlock. 1st: light and sacred flame, bonus spells, and a pool of d6s to heal at range. 6th: resist radiant and add Charisma to radiant and fire spells. 10th: you and allies get temporary hit points after rests. 14th: once a day, rise from 0 hit points in a blinding blast.
Subclass.The Fathomless: Warlock. 1st: sea spells, a spectral tentacle that strikes with cold and slows foes, and you swim and breathe underwater. 6th: resist cold, and the tentacle can shield allies. 10th: cast Evard's black tentacles freely. 14th: teleport yourself and allies to water up to a mile away.
Subclass.The Fiend: Warlock. 1st: fiend spells, and temporary hit points when you drop a foe. 6th: add a d10 to a check or save once per rest. 10th: choose a damage resistance each rest. 14th: hurl a creature through hell for heavy psychic damage once a day.
Subclass.The Genie: Warlock. 1st: genie spells, a magic vessel you can hide inside, and extra damage of your genie's type once a turn. 6th: resist that type and fly briefly. 10th: shelter allies in your vessel. 14th: once in a while, a limited wish.
Subclass.The Great Old One: Warlock. 1st: mind spells and telepathy with anyone nearby. 6th: give an attacker disadvantage once per rest. 10th: resist psychic damage, and reflect it. 14th: enslave an incapacitated humanoid's mind.
Subclass.The Hexblade: Warlock. 1st: hexblade spells, a curse for extra damage and critical hits on 19 or 20, plus medium armor, shields, martial weapons and Charisma for weapon attacks. 6th: raise a slain humanoid as a specter. 10th: the curse can make attacks miss you. 14th: curse another foe when the first falls.
Subclass.Bladesinging: Wizard. 2nd: light armor and a one-handed weapon, and Bladesong for extra AC, speed and concentration. 6th: Extra Attack (one can be a cantrip). 10th: spend slots to block damage while singing. 14th: add Intelligence to melee damage while singing.
Subclass.Order of Scribes: Wizard. 2nd: a magic quill that copies spells fast, and an awakened spellbook that can change your spells' damage type and speed up rituals. 6th: a spectral mind you can see and cast through. 10th: write spell scrolls quickly. 14th: the spellbook can take damage for you.
Subclass.School of Abjuration: Wizard. 2nd: copy abjuration spells cheaply, and an arcane ward that soaks damage, recharged by casting abjurations. 6th: the ward can protect allies. 10th: add proficiency to dispel and counterspell checks. 14th: advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.
Subclass.School of Conjuration: Wizard. 2nd: copy conjuration spells cheaply, and conjure small objects. 6th: teleport or swap places with an ally. 10th: damage can't break your conjuration concentration. 14th: your summoned creatures get 30 temporary hit points.
Subclass.School of Divination: Wizard. 2nd: copy divination spells cheaply, and Portent: roll two d20s each day and swap them for any roll you see. 6th: casting divinations gives back lower spell slots. 10th: a third eye for darkvision, ethereal sight, reading languages or seeing invisible. 14th: three portent dice.
Subclass.School of Enchantment: Wizard. 2nd: copy enchantment spells cheaply, and a hypnotic gaze that holds a creature still. 6th: redirect an attacker to another target. 10th: enchantment spells can target a second creature. 14th: change a charmed creature's memories.
Subclass.School of Evocation: Wizard. 2nd: copy evocation spells cheaply, and protect allies from your area spells. 6th: cantrips deal half damage even on a save. 10th: add Intelligence to evocation damage. 14th: maximise a spell's damage, at a growing cost to yourself.
Subclass.School of Illusion: Wizard. 2nd: copy illusion spells cheaply, and a better minor illusion. 6th: reshape your lasting illusions. 10th: an illusory double makes an attack miss. 14th: make part of an illusion real for a minute.
Subclass.School of Necromancy: Wizard. 2nd: copy necromancy spells cheaply, and heal when your spells kill. 6th: stronger, more numerous undead servants. 10th: resist necrotic damage, and your hit point maximum can't be lowered. 14th: take control of undead.
Subclass.School of Transmutation: Wizard. 2nd: copy transmutation spells cheaply, and temporarily change materials. 6th: a transmuter's stone with a choice of perks. 10th: polymorph yourself freely once per rest. 14th: spend the stone on a major effect such as curing, restoring youth or raising the dead.
Subclass.War Magic: Wizard. 2nd: a reaction for +2 AC or +4 to a save, and Intelligence to initiative. 6th: store power from dispelling to add force damage. 10th: +2 AC and saves while concentrating. 14th: your deflection also damages nearby foes.
